dedupe_keys.name: blue green infrastructure sand and leaf litter maintenance experiments

description: This collection measures how sand and leaf-litter accumulation affect infiltration-based blue-green infrastructure. Eawag, ETH Zürich and Universidade da Coruña researchers tested two approximately 3.84-square-metre vegetated boxes under controlled rainfall in A Coruña. The repository places experiments in April 2024. Soil-moisture and tipping-bucket records accompany increasing sand loads of two to eighteen kilograms per square metre and leaf-litter totals of 0.3–1.725 kilograms. The public repository provides a ZIP of raw CSV and processed text data with MATLAB preparation functions and a README. DataCite states CC0 1.0, supporting free reuse despite empty licence fields in the repository API. Bench-scale geometry and prescribed thirty-minute storms are limitations for transfer to operational drainage assets. Modellers could calibrate clogging and retention responses in stormwater simulations using model-epa-swmm. The named API and README were accessible while the HTML landing page showed bot protection. No dataset archive was downloaded or experiment recalculated.
